name: UpdateGatewayServiceCheck

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the health check
parameters.name: check

parameters.help_en: The expected status code, which is required if the health check protocol is HTTP
parameters.help_zh: 正常状态码（健康检查协议为HTTP时必填）
parameters.name: expected_statuses

parameters.help_en:
The health check protocol. Valid values:

HTTP
TCP
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查协议，目前支持：
HTTP
TCP
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The timeout period of responses to the health check. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 健康检查响应超时时间（秒）
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: The interval at which the health check is performed
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The healthy threshold of the health check
parameters.name: healthy_threshold

parameters.help_en: The unhealthy threshold of the health check
parameters.name: unhealthy_threshold

parameters.help_en: The health check path, which is required if the health check protocol is HTTP
parameters.help_zh: 健康检查路径（健康检查协议为HTTP时必填）

parameters.help_zh: 健康检查域名（健康检查协议为HTTP时选填）

parameters.help_en: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh and en. zh indicates Chinese, which is the default value. en indicates English
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
